title: Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Omnimodal Reasoning Models
summary: Xiaomi's unified native multimodal model family featuring a 1 million token context window across text, image, video, and audio inputs. It utilizes a sparse Mixture-of-Experts architecture and hybrid attention to achieve high efficiency in complex agentic tasks.
research_notes: Includes MiMo-V2.5-Pro with over 1 trillion parameters (42B active) and competitive performance on SWE-bench Pro benchmarks.

evolution.summary: The series transitioned from specialized V1.0/V2.0 models to a unified architecture in V2.5, which was open-sourced under the MIT License in April 2026 and integrated into the HyperOS ecosystem for sub-second responses on mobile devices.
